audience: field service companies that run work orders, estimates and invoices in ServiceBridge

useCases.title: Plan the work orders for a date range
useCases.text: List work orders for a date range, customer, location or status. Open one to see its visits and lines. List the teams to check who can take a job.

useCases.title: Find a customer and their open estimates
useCases.text: Search the customers by name. List the estimates of that customer, filtered by status.

useCases.title: Review invoices and payments for a period
useCases.text: List invoices filtered by status or date, and list the payments for the same period. Read the invoice totals per period.

useCases.title: Log a follow-up note and task
useCases.text: Add an activity note to a customer, job, invoice or location. Create a follow-up task, optionally for a customer.

useCases.title: Add a new lead or customer
useCases.text: Create a sales lead or a customer. Change the name, type or notes of a customer; only the fields you pass change.
